slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: parties
slots.about: id (1..n), label; who or what an entry is with

slots.name: records
slots.about: saved: id, date, party, title, amount (+ in, - out)

slots.name: unit_before
slots.about: before every amount, empty if none

slots.name: unit_after
slots.about: after every amount, with a leading space if a word

slots.name: balance_word
slots.about: above the balance when nobody is picked

slots.name: with_word
slots.about: before a picked party's name above the balance, with a trailing space

slots.name: less_word
slots.about: goes back to the last entry only

slots.name: empty_line
slots.about: shown when the picked party has no entries

everyone.shows: the balance of every entry, the last entry, a count to open all

one_party.shows: the balance with that party, its last entry; a tap on the same face goes back

labels.face: the party's name, and picked_word when picked
labels.more: all_word with the count, or less_word

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise and smooth
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a picked face is spoken as picked; every amount carries its sign
